tools.description: Fork a database into a branch, optionally at a changes cursor.
tools.name: branch_create

tools.description: List a database's branches and its own lineage.
tools.name: branch_list

tools.description: Read the changes feed from a cursor (absent = from the start). Returns the changes and the next cursor.
tools.name: changes

tools.description: Add a context to a working set: the contexts you work with, which context_materialize and context_import can copy locally for offline use. Omit working_set to create one; the answer's id is the working set to pass next. Logical: nothing is opened or copied. Example: {"context": "otp/tools"}.

credential_ref.description: Name of a token in the node's ctx_credentials, for a remote location.

mode.description: Which location of the card to use. Default: local if the card has one, else remote.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...). Omit to create a new working set.

tools.name: context_attach

tools.description: What a context query may look like: the accepted statement shapes with examples, the merges, the limits (contexts per query, largest LIMIT, timeouts), working-set budgets and whether the node is offline. Call it before a first context_query. No arguments.
tools.name: context_capabilities

tools.description: Remove a context from a working set; a saved slice of it is deleted. Returns the working set. Example: {"working_set": "ws_...", "context": "otp/eunit"}.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...), from context_attach or context_working_sets.

tools.name: context_detach

tools.description: Find contexts about a topic: every word of q must appear in a card's name, title, description or topics (a plural matches its stem). A filter, not a ranking: other contexts may still hold answers. Returns {contexts, summary}. Example: {"q": "release"}.

q.description: Words to look for, e.g. "release handling".

tools.name: context_discover

tools.description: Import a published snapshot (a directory written by an export, holding manifest.json) into this node, read only, as a working-set member that answers offline for that generation. Omit working_set to create one. Example: {"dir": "/srv/export_sasl_g1"}.

dir.description: Path of the export directory on this node.

name.description: Local database name for the copy. Default: derived from the context and generation.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...). Omit to create a new working set.

tools.name: context_import

tools.description: Read one context card: where it lives (local db, or remote endpoint and db), title, topics, embedding. Example: {"context": "otp/sasl"}.
tools.name: context_inspect

tools.description: List the registered contexts: named datasets, each a database on this node or on a remote Barrel server. Returns {contexts: [card]}; pass a card's name (or id) to the other context tools. Example: {"prefix": "otp/"}.

prefix.description: Only names starting with this text, e.g. "otp/".

tools.name: context_list

tools.description: Save the documents a query returns into a working set so they answer offline: one frozen slice per answering context, holding exactly those documents (by id). Omit working_set to create one. A context already in the working set must be detached first. Example: {"from_query": {"query": "SELECT b.id FROM bm25_top_k('test', k => 5) AS b", "contexts": ["otp/eunit"]}}.

from_query.description: The query whose rows (by id) are saved.

query.description: A BQL statement returning the id of each document.

embeddings.description: Copy vectors (needed for vector search on the slice).

max_bytes.description: Refuse the slice when the fetched documents are larger than this.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...). Omit to create a new working set.

tools.name: context_materialize

tools.description: Read or switch the node's offline mode. Offline, remote contexts are skipped and never contacted; local databases, slices and snapshots still answer. Omit offline to read the mode. Example: {"offline": true}.

offline.description: true to go offline, false to go back online.

tools.name: context_offline

tools.description: Run one BQL statement over several contexts (names or ids) or over a working set. Returns rows (or groups per context), one sources entry per context saying whether it answered and what its answer covers, and a summary: read it first. Row queries need LIMIT (<= 1000); add ORDER BY a selected field to merge rows in order. isError is true when no context answered. Example: {"query": "SELECT id, lines FROM c ORDER BY lines DESC LIMIT 10", "contexts": ["otp/tools", "otp/sasl"]}.

contexts.description: Context names or ids. Give this or working_set, not both.

deadline_ms.description: Deadline for the whole request, at most 60000.

max_parallel.description: Remote contexts queried at once, at most 16.

merge.description: Leave unset for the default: ordered with ORDER BY, grouped otherwise, score for comparable vector_top_k.

offline.description: true: answer from local copies only, never contact a remote server. Default: the node's offline mode.

params.description: Values for $name parameters in the statement.

query.description: One BQL statement. Strings use single quotes. Shapes: see context_capabilities.
examples: SELECT id, path FROM c ORDER BY path LIMIT 20
SELECT b.id, b._score FROM bm25_top_k('release upgrade', k => 5) AS b

working_set.description: A working-set id (ws_...) instead of contexts: queries its members, local copies first.

tools.name: context_query

tools.description: Delete a working set and the slices it saved (imported snapshots stay). Example: {"working_set": "ws_..."}.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...), from context_attach or context_working_sets.

tools.name: context_working_set_delete

tools.description: List the working sets on this node with their member names, or, given working_set, read one in full: each member's mode, membership (what its answers cover), answers_offline, budget, usage and a summary. Example: {} or {"working_set": "ws_..."}.

working_set.description: Working-set id (ws_...), from context_attach or context_working_sets.

tools.name: context_working_sets

tools.description: Create (or open) a database by name.
tools.name: db_create

tools.description: Info about a database: document count, lineage, retention.
tools.name: db_info

tools.description: List the databases currently open on this node (scoped to your grant).
tools.name: db_list

tools.description: Delete a document by id.
tools.name: doc_delete

tools.description: Read a document by id.
tools.name: doc_get

tools.description: Write a document (the doc object must carry its id). Optional session tags the write's provenance.
tools.name: doc_put

tools.description: Accept a handoff by presenting its token: opens the shared space and creates a session in it (context is read in place).
tools.name: handoff_accept

tools.description: Complete a handoff (revokes its token by default).
tools.name: handoff_complete

tools.description: Hand work off: issues a capability for the space and returns its token once; whoever holds the token accepts.
tools.name: handoff_create

tools.description: Handoffs, filtered by space, status, to_agent, from_agent (capability callers see their own space only).
tools.name: handoff_list

tools.description: Merge a branch back into its parent.
tools.name: merge

tools.description: Exact substring or regex search over a database's documents via a trigram index. mode literal (default) or regex; each hit carries the document id and match spans.
tools.name: ngram_search

tools.description: Run a BQL query. Rows are bounded by max_rows (default 100, cap 1000); pass the returned continuation to page. SUBSCRIBE statements are rejected: use query_subscribe.
tools.name: query

tools.description: Start a live query from a BQL SUBSCRIBE statement. Returns a resource URI: read it for the materialized rows, subscribe to it for update notifications.
tools.name: query_subscribe

tools.description: Stop a live query by sub id.
tools.name: query_unsubscribe

tools.description: Search a database: mode bm25 or hybrid with a query string, mode vector with a query vector.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Append a message to a session's history.
tools.name: session_add_message

tools.description: Create a working session in a space (sliding TTL).
tools.name: session_create

tools.description: A session's messages in chronological order (since/before unix ms, limit, order asc|desc).
tools.name: session_get_messages

tools.description: Slide a session's TTL.
tools.name: session_touch

tools.description: Create a space: a shared context database agents reach with capability tokens. Management only.
tools.name: space_create

tools.description: Issue a capability token for a space (rights: read, write, admin). The token is shown once.
tools.name: space_grant

tools.description: The registry document of a space.
tools.name: space_info

tools.description: Revoke a grant of a space by token id.
tools.name: space_revoke
